content: Medium close-up of Arthur Morgan (black hat, beard, brown vest, blue-grey striped sleeves, bandolier) centred slightly right, front-facing, against painted sunset: orange/purple sky, white sun low left at ~38%,60%, snow-capped mountains, grass strip foreground. Painted background with art-type: flat outlined character
Wanted poster (parchment, 'WANTED', grayscale portrait of Arthur in frame, ARTHUR MORGAN, WANTED FOR, list, REWARD $?) centred on dark red-brown wood-plank wall with vignette

Wide dusk landscape: black silhouette of Arthur on horse (centre, in front of big white-yellow sun) with a posse of silhouetted horsemen on both horizons (left 3, right 3-4); orange/purple sky with cloud bands, hills, pyramid-like rock at right. Flat silhouette art
Full-body Arthur front view standing, hand on hip (left hand on holster), blue shirt sleeves, brown vest, hat; orange-to-purple sunset sky, small mountains, dark plain. Wide-ish full figure centred
Very dark scene: single cone spotlight from top onto elliptical pool on floor (centre), blurred orange bokeh circles left/right, drifting dust specks; a brass revolver bullet falls and spins

Night scene: dark navy silhouette of Arthur in hat in 3/4 view facing right, hand holding white handkerchief to mouth (coughing); full moon with halo upper left, blue snowy mountains behind, starry sky
Open storybook, flat front view, cream pages with ruled lines, on dark brown background; lit candle at left in warm glow circle

Cartoon log cabin interior: baby Arthur (big round head, curl on top, angry brows) in wooden cradle with red V emblem on rocking base, on colourful oval braided rug, toy wooden horse on wheels at right (blue saddle, string), stone fireplace left edge, window top-right with curtains showing night/silhouette outside; wood-plank wall, wooden floor; drifting dust sparkles

Cabin interior, wider: Beatrice (mother, dark bun hair, purple-grey dress) standing on braided rug holding baby Arthur in arms, stone fireplace left with animated fire, red rocking chair right, window top-right with moon and blue night, wood-plank wall

Cabin bedroom at night: nightstand with candle and framed oval portrait of Beatrice, small bed with red/white patchwork quilt, child Arthur asleep with head on pillow, window top-right with curtains showing moon/mountains; warm candle glow halo

Close-up: cream portrait card with oval frame showing Beatrice (smiling, bun) standing upright centred ~50%,42%, tilted slightly; soft-focus cabin with window (moon) at left and candle at right; warm vignette

Blurred night camp background: pine silhouettes, glowing moon with cloud bite upper right, campfire at right bottom, long red-orange log/bar at bottom (blurred, possibly a UI bar or log), fireflies; Beatrice portrait card in front centre-left (~25%,60%)

Beatrice portrait card (oval frame, smiling bun-haired woman) floating centre-left over pale cream blurred wall with hanging oil lantern (right, ~78%,25%) and a shelf/bench line; warm soft vignette; minimal dust specks at bottom

Cabin interior wide, desaturated dim lighting: young Arthur (boy, brown hair, sad frown) stands at right (~63%,62%) clutching Beatrice's portrait; empty rocking chair centre with red cushion, small side table with lit candle at left, braided rug, window top-right with moon; at left edge stone fireplace, cold and dark

Wooden plank wall left (60%) opening to sunset town at right: pink-orange sky, two-storey HOTEL and SALOON buildings, barrel at bottom right, dusty boardwalk with mud puddles; Lyle (your dad; black hat with striped band, goatee, brown coat) stands front-facing at 30%,60% arms out

Mugshot studio: cream wall with horizontal height-chart lines and dark brown floor band; Lyle (small, centred at 50%,22%) holds black slate sign; large black bellows camera on tripod in left foreground (brass lens) pointing at him; T-shaped pole at left; warm oval vignette
(continuation) same night street shot runs f1027-f1079; slow push-in, Lyle sways side to side with half-closed eyes (indifferent), boy sad. Camera subtly drifts upward f1050-1079
(continuation) dark wall shot ends f1210 with only YEARS LATER label and speech bubble on empty wall, lantern glow at left; bubble/label stay static f1166-f1210
Close-up of Lyle (head and shoulders, large striped-band hat, goatee) centred at 53%,55% against orange-to-purple sunset sky, mesa silhouettes, cloud bands, sun rays; flat cartoon
Black cowboy hat with braided gold-brown band hangs on a horizontal wood-plank wall from a hook, centred at 49%,48% w~33%; warm radial spotlight glow behind; wall otherwise plain

Night street: row of western buildings (BANK red-brick, GENERAL STORE green, DOC.. tan, GUNSMITH cream) with lit windows and hanging lanterns across the middle, tall lamppost right with lit lantern and full moon halo, dark navy sky with stars, dirt street with puddles; teen/young Arthur (brown spiky hair, ragged brown coat) stands front-facing centre at 50%,62% with stern brows
Night bakery street, dark purple plank wall, wood floor, lit BAKERY window (bread on shelves) right; boy character (brown hair, brown coat) medium-wide full-body at left-centre; static camera

Daytime Western main street, blue sky with white sun glow top-centre, saloon/doctor/bank facades (parallax-scrolling background), striped-awning APPLES stall with GAZETTE + DOCTOR posters; boy at left of stall, medium-wide; background pans slowly (BANK building scrolls in f1466-1470)

Dark night alley between two plank walls in one-point perspective, lit warm window (3 yellow squares) at back, crate and barrel right, boy sleeping sitting on/by a burlap sack, eyes closed, centre; medium shot, static camera (tiny settle)

Night Western street, deep blue sky with full moon + glow (top right), lit buildings HOTEL / GENERAL STORE / DOCTOR with warm windows, street lamp left, puddles on ground; Dutch (slicked black hair, moustache, black vest, red scarf, white shirt sleeves) centre-left medium-wide, gesturing with open arms; slight camera drift
Hosea interior shot (f1707-1796): warm wood-plank wall, lantern top-right, yellow window edge left, floating dust motes; Hosea centre-right; static, slight parallax drift of dust particles

Night campsite: moon + glow top-centre, dark pine silhouettes + snowy peaks, covered wagon + log bench left, beige A-frame tent right, campfire bottom-left-centre (flame flicker); left to right Dutch seated on log (moustache), Hosea (bowler) standing centre-left, Arthur-boy (brown hair, brown coat) centre-right; medium-wide; slow push-in/drift (characters scale up slightly f1797-1830)

Same night camp but tighter: Dutch (left) and Arthur (right) sit/stand behind a log in the foreground with an open blank book standing on the log centre; tent right, wagon wheel left, moon top-centre, fire glow bottom; medium

Dusk meadow: pink-purple sky, mountains, pine trees, grass and rocks; green chalkboard on easel centre; Dutch left holding pointer stick toward board, small Arthur beside easel, Hosea right (bowler, red card fan, eyes-closed smile from f1974); medium-wide; slow push-in begins (board top rises y 12%->6%?)
Dark brown wood-plank tabletop board with horizontal plank lines and vignette; polaroid photos appear one by one in a row (flat top-down infographic style)

Night camp, low angle behind log: Dutch (left), Arthur (middle, shorter) and Hosea (right) stand in a row behind log with arms around each other's shoulders, campfire bottom-centre, tent right, wagon left, moon top; medium; slow push-in (log lifts from y~85% f2122 to ~75% f2159)
Sepia monochrome polaroid of the camp family (Dutch, Arthur, Hosea behind log, fire glow) centred, slightly rotated, on dark brown vignette; slow drift

Inside a canvas tent, warm tan/sepia with strong vignette: Arthur (young) stands on a wooden crate holding an open journal at centre-left, lantern top-left, red hanging sack/banner right, green bedroll on floor right; tent seams radiate from top; floating dust motes; medium; static camera

Close-up of a large blank open book (cream pages, brown cover edge, red ribbon bookmark at bottom) centred on dark wood-plank desk with warm lantern glow top-left and floating dust; top-down; book w~55% x h~48%

Snow-covered mountain camp with snowy pines, mountains, beige A-frame tent right, Arthur standing centre (looks slightly older over time), sun/moon with streak trail; time-lapse: sky cycles day -> purple dusk -> starry night -> purple -> day about every 7-8 frames; a sapling at left grows into a large tree; snow melts to grass/dry meadow by ~f2572 (white ground -> yellow-green)

Extreme close-up of adult Arthur (spiky brown hair, ragged brown coat/vest, eyes closed smile, pink cheeks) at right-centre over blurred (depth-of-field) sunset: orange-purple gradient sky, big glowing sun right, purple mountains + pines, tent left; camera static with slight head bob

Adult Arthur Morgan full-body (black hat, blue sleeves, brown leather vest with diagonal strap, satchel, gunbelt), hands on hips, centred; sunset sky orange-purple with radial light rays from behind him; silhouettes of covered wagons left and right, mountains, elliptical ground ring at feet; realistic-proportioned (not big-head) character; wide/full-length; hero pose

Night camp wide-medium: covered wagon left, Dutch (red vest, black hair, full-body realistic proportion) left-centre with arm extended around adult Arthur (black hat, brown vest) centre-right, glowing tent right, small campfire bottom, moon top-right with glow; slow push-in (wagon wheels and tent grow f2686->2750)
Arthur Morgan chest-up front-facing in black hat, brown vest, blue-grey sleeves, over painted orange/purple desert sunset with mesas, sun at left, light rays; flat outlined art

Wide static-looking camp: green/brown covered wagon left, tent right, pines, blue sky with sun and clouds; four characters standing: Dutch (left, red scarf/vest, arm on kid), scrawny kid (Arthur as a boy, dark hair, beside Dutch), Hosea-like man in orange vest (centre-right, small), Arthur adult arms-crossed (right, dark hat)

Wide farm: Dutch (red vest, hands on hips) and the kid at right, three angry farmers/ranchers at left raising fists, pitchforks, one torch; white farmhouse behind, wooden fence, mountains, blue sky with big sun, field

Young John-like kid (dark bowl hair, suspenders, arms crossed) centre-left in front of canvas tent; blurred (depth-of-field) background with pines, mountains, big sun top-centre; small blurred Arthur (hat) figure standing right at 80%

Journal page 'THINGS TO REMEMBER' leather-bordered parchment centred over dark wood-plank bg with dust motes; red ribbon bookmark bottom-left; small doodle of Dutch's face at top-right with handwritten 'Dutch' and a horse doodle at bottom-right
(continuation of bank vault wide shot f3220-3368)
(loot close-up f3369-3432)

Sunny Western town main street: HOTEL/SALOON/GUNSMITH storefronts, blue sky bright sun top-right, dirt street; foreground left-to-right: Arthur (dark hat, brown vest, hands at belt), small blonde girl in white dress (Jenny-like) , woman in pale grey/blue dress with apron, a boy in brown at right; townspeople far right
(night camp wide f3502-3561; Dutch waves throughout; Arthur and Hosea sit still, small breathing)
Dutch waist-up centre-left, waving right hand (viewer's right), glowing tent with lantern light at right, pines silhouette left, deep navy sky with moon top-centre-right and halo, stars

Porch of white clapboard house at sunset: Arthur (bare-headed, hat held at chest, arms crossed, brown vest, blue sleeves, holster) left; Mary (white blouse, navy long skirt, braid, hands folded) right in front of tan door; flower boxes under windows; purple-pink sky, pink mountain, fence, sun glow bottom-left

Same porch/sunset set, wider lower framing: Arthur (hat on) kneeling on one knee at centre-left reaching right arm to Mary, offering a small gold ring; Mary right in white blouse/navy skirt holding hands to chest, later covers mouth with hand (emotional) f3770+; white pillar and door right
(father at door shot f3782-3842, tag HER/FATHER + arrow + anger mark persist; Arthur still tipping hat)

Sunset desert crossroads: Arthur centre-right front-facing (hat, vest, hands near belt then one hand on hip from f3872), wooden signpost post left of him; far left small white house, far right two canvas camp tents with glowing lamp light; big sun and pink mountains, layered purple clouds

Night at porch: Arthur at left in dark blue silhouette-ish shading (hat, arms at belt, back-lit), moonlit mountain behind; grey-blue clapboard house; Mary in warm yellow-lit doorway centre; windows glow yellow with flower boxes at right

Wooden-plank cabin interior (warm brown), bright white-blue window at right; Arthur (hat, vest) left-centre holding a swaddled baby bundle in both arms at chest; Mary (white blouse, maroon skirt with white apron) right beside window; dust motes

Cream wood-panel diner interior: Arthur (hat, dark vest, hand on hip) at left foreground; Eliza (waitress: white blouse, hair bun, hand on hip) behind brown counter at centre; shelf of jars/cups top-left, window with red curtains showing green meadow at right, cloche dish and mug on counter
(horse/cabin day shot f4059-4115; JAN calendar settled f4101, snow cabin, bare tree, boy waving at cabin; sun with glow/rays at 74%,10%; chimney smoke puffs f4059-4115)

Dark stormy dusk prairie: heavy navy storm clouds, vignette, olive-green desaturated field; log cabin (smaller, dark window) centre-left, tree right; Arthur on horse in black silhouette occupying left (x 0-30%), walking/standing; no characters near the cabin; faint stars/specks
Full-body character on stormy overcast field with mountains + tree; character centre ~50%,60% tall ~85%; static, subtle idle sway
Medium close-up Arthur (black hat, scarf, bandolier) at night camp, moon upper right, wagon left, glowing tent right; open journal/book lower-left on table
Campfire camp night: Arthur right (hat, medium close-up), campfire left, moon top, bg warm purple haze; Arthur subtle breathing/blink; fire flickers continuously, sparks
Black screen chapter card
Wide flat vector sunset river scene: red/white paddle steamboat centre-left, pine silhouettes, town silhouette right, orange sun glow, purple water; smoke puffs from stack; floating glints

Wide-medium flat cartoon night camp: tent left (glowing), dark-haired mustached man (left, waves right hand) and blond man in white hat (right, hands on hips) standing either side of small table, lantern post, covered wagon right, full moon top-left, floating firefly dots

Top-down-ish flat shot of wood-plank wall with large parchment map (blue river, small steamboat with crosshair, brick-like buildings top-left with dotted line, compass icon bottom right), blue enamel mug and revolver bottom-right, gold coins bottom-left

Wide flat shot sunset river: wooden pier in perspective, two men standing side by side (left: dark hat, dark coat arms crossed = Arthur-like; right: hat, orange vest white sleeves hands on hips), sacks and crates lower right, steamboat with funnel behind right, orange/purple sky

Interior wooden cabin: two men (dark-haired mustache left, white-hat blond right) behind large wooden chest topped with banded cash stacks; two round porthole windows with sunset left and right; hanging lantern top centre; dark vignette
Same steamboat-at-dock sunset scene (continues from 4812, boat now centre-right): black silhouette lawmen enter from left in sequence aiming pistols at the boat; crates/sack lower-left
Dark maroon wall of building with four glowing orange windows; huge black silhouette of lone gunman left (35% x), pistol extended right; sparse dust particles
Dark maroon wall of building with four glowing orange windows; huge black silhouette of lone gunman left (35% x), pistol extended right; sparse dust particles

Very dark night: navy sky, blue-grey river band at ~55% y, wooden deck foreground with two fallen hats (brown left, grey/white centre) and small lantern/red-white item right; misty smoke puff at left; extremely wide, mostly static
Same wooden wall with parchment map, revolver lower right; map now includes BLACKWATER label, red ellipse around steamboat, red X

Dark navy night: full moon top-right, pine silhouettes; covered wagon with white speed lines and glowing lantern centre-left, a second horse-drawn wagon far left, Arthur silhouette riding horse in foreground right; dust puffs bottom-left; flat dark art

Snowy pale-blue mountain landscape (big peak centre, small snowy pines), wagon with horse team misty in background left, Arthur on brown horse walking/standing right of centre (70%,60%), dark vignette corners

Wide snow village at dusk-blue: row of dark navy silhouettes (woman with long dress + child at left, three men with hands on hips centre-right, others) facing away; snowy cabin with crossed boards (X) centre-left, snowy pines, mountains; vignette
Medium close-up of bearded Arthur in dark purple-blue cabin interior: hat with icicles, scarf, shivering; stove (left) with pipe, blue frosted window top-left casting pale light cone; wood plank wall

Wide-medium snowy scene: bearded Arthur (left, brown vest, blue sleeves, black hat) and Sadie (right, yellow shirt, brown pants, cowboy hat) standing side by side before wooden fence, snowy pines, snowy mountains, dark mine-frame/shack right; flat cartoon
Closer snow scene: Sadie left (yellow shirt, rifle held at side) and bearded Arthur right (arms crossed -> hand on belt), mountains and pines behind, fence at far left; no tag
Wide snow scene: beige A-frame tent left, lone navy silhouette man standing (hands on hips) at 55%,70% facing away, snowy pines, mountains, footprints in snow near tent; vignette

Wide snowy mountain landscape, grey-blue sky, snowy pines, pale snow ground with footprints; dark-clothed rider on black horse walking left-to-right (continues from before range). Painted flat background, vignette

Night mountain scene, dark navy sky with stars, large glowing moon top-right (halo), snowy cliff left with rifleman (dark hat, rifle) standing on top, pine forest and mountains behind; a small figure in lower right below

Very large full moon centre-left (35%,25%) behind dark hill silhouette with pine trees and small snowy peaks; foreground pale snow strip bottom with footprints and a brown cowboy hat lying in snow at 66%,95%
Medium close-up of long-dark-haired man in grey coat, orange vest, black shirt, looking at camera, centred-right (62%,55%); dark brown wood-plank wall with orange vignette glow, floating dust specks

Wide night snowy camp: Dutch-like man in dark coat standing on wooden crate (center 52%,45%) with raised right hand waving/preaching; silhouetted crowd of men in foreground (black shapes, hats), campfire at 38%,70% flickering, snow-covered log cabin with lit window at 80%,55%, snowy pines, mountains, large moon with halo top-right 72%,12%

Wooden plank wall (warm brown, orange glow right) with hanging wooden sign DUTCH'S PLANS at upper-left/centre and cream paper board THINGS TO REMEMBER at bottom-right; floating dust specks. Recurring tally sign + list
chapter card on black

Wide establishing: brown rock cliff left (0-35%, 62-100%) with wagon (green wheels, canvas cover), two A-frame tents, and a brown horse standing at cliff edge; below/right a wide valley: winding blue river, green meadow, row of small pale buildings (Valentine town) in the distance at 63%,55%, snowy blue mountains, fog band at horizon, sun with halo top-centre

Medium-wide daytime camp: top-hat man with suspenders holding a paper/recipe sheet standing behind a cauldron over a campfire (30%,60%); canvas A-tents mid, covered wagon right (85%,45%), pines and mountains behind, bright sun halo top-centre (50%,12%)

Medium wide: old grey-bearded man (Uncle) in orange shirt, blue neckerchief, suspenders, seated on folding stool in front of big canvas A-tent (left); a rye bottle on grass at his right (58%,78%); pines, blue mountains, sun top-centre with halo; green meadow

Medium wide camp: Arthur (black hat, beard, brown vest, blue shirt) standing, hands on hips/gripping axe handle, chopping stump with axe in front (33%,55%); canvas tent left, covered wagon behind green chalkboard CHORES (72%,40%), pines, mountains, sun top-centre with halo; green meadow

Wide western street: big wooden SALOON building left (0-45%, 5-85%) with sign 'SALOON' (cream sign, black serif caps, at 25%,10%), glowing orange swing doors and a large window (center-right of building); distant street of shops GENERAL STORE / HOTEL / DOCTOR / GUNSMITH (right); blue sky, sun with halo at 80%,8%; dirt street with puddles

Medium shot: Arthur (hat, beard, vest, hands on hips) standing left (31%,62%), bald bearded loser seated hunched right (66%,72%) with yellow stars circling his head (dizzy), shop row GENERAL STORE / HOTEL / DOCTOR / GUNSM behind, saloon edge with broken window at far left, pale blue sky, sun halo top-right (80%,8%), glass shards and puddles on ground
Long static hold (~6.5 s): dimmed night camp with comment prompt panel; only fire flicker, ember specks and slight tent-lantern glow animate; no camera move; panel text unchanged

Interior of canvas tent: cream wall, red-brown wooden floor, open flap at left showing green hill (0-18%), vertical wooden tent pole at 50%, small hanging lantern on pole (53%,22%), table at right with black strongbox (65%,50%), stack of gold coins (73%,52%) and a glowing oil lantern (80%,48%); bald man in brown three-piece suit (Strauss) standing left of pole (40%,50%) with hand on vest/pocket watch

Medium-wide sunny farm: Arthur (hat, beard, vest, crossbody strap) at left (31%,62%) and thin farmer in straw hat, white shirt, black suspenders, blue jeans holding a hoe at right (64%,62%); red barn left (22%,50%), white two-storey farmhouse right (80%,50%), wooden fence, grey mountains, bright sun with halo top-centre (37%,13%), small white cloud top-right, tan field foreground
Red barn front-on, centered, farmhouse small left, flat painted field; still image, no obvious camera move

Tight two-shot: Arthur (left, dark skin tone shaded, black hat) and Thomas (right, sallow, straw hat) from chest up, blurred red barn and farmhouse behind, sun top; Thomas coughs; Arthur's face tinted darker/shadowed progressively

Close-ish view of white clapboard farmhouse porch, sunset-blue sky; Edith (Thomas's wife, brown shawl, grey dress) stands in open brown door at right; Arthur as big black silhouette (hat, profile) at left foreground

Interior of wooden-plank cabin, dark brown walls; Edith standing left-centre wringing hands, sick Thomas sitting on chair at right (head in hand/coughing); window top right with light shaft falling diagonally to floor
Arthur close-up, chest up, centred-left, darker sick-tinted face, blurred barn left / farmhouse right, sun behind hat; no meter

Wide sunset: orange-magenta gradient sky, big low sun right behind Arthur on a brown horse (side view facing right, centre-right), Downes farmhouse small left with chimney smoke, mountains, wooden fence, dusty field. Arthur riding away
Dark brown wood-plank wall with vignette; pinned sepia photo (polaroid) of Arthur and Thomas coughing (the earlier two-shot, sepia treated)
Chapter card on black

Dusk camp: Dutch (dark coat, red neckerchief, one hand raised in wave/stop) at right, hanging wooden DUTCH'S PLANS sign from tree-branch gallows at left, white canvas tents + wagon edges both sides, pine tree line, purple lake, campfire small bottom centre; magenta-orange sunset sky; floating firefly/dust specks

Arthur on brown horse riding (walk cycle) in front of canvas covered wagon at left; orange-yellow dusk road, dark tree silhouette backdrop, tall green weeping tree right, wooden signpost SOUTH at right

Green lawn at dusk, orange-purple sky; pink-brick mansion left and white-columned mansion right; Dutch centre holding two wooden control bars with strings to two marionette puppets (top-hat man left in black tuxedo, white-suit man with white hat right)

Tighter puppeteer shot: Dutch centre from knees up, arms raised high holding control bars, strings crossing to two puppets (top-hat Grays puppet left, white-suited Braithwaite puppet right), mansions behind

Western street facade, front-on, blue dusk sky: buildings with signs SALOON (green), GENERAL STORE (brown), HOTEL (tan, balcony), DOCTOR (blue-grey); dirt road with a grey puddle at bottom centre; chimney smoke rising from hotel; flat painted bg, slight blur
Burning mansion at night (continuation): white mansion with roof flames, window flames, door fire; two silhouetted riders left, one right; dark starry sky, tall trees silhouettes edges

Night wide: big moon with halo upper left, deep blue sky, silhouetted Arthur on horse (centre-left) beside a covered wagon with glowing lantern and a line of riders/horses on right; distant city skyline with thousands of yellow window lights; pink-orange smoke/glow at left horizon

Saint Denis city street continues: Arthur centre, pedestrians left/right; brick tenements; sepia dusk sun low behind centre; lamp posts at both edges; telegraph wires; green tram marked 'ST. DENIS' glides across from left to right behind Arthur

Night: Dutch (centre-right, dark coat, red neckerchief) chest-up with mansion lit by lantern behind him right, weeping-willow Spanish moss tree at left, dark blue starry sky, small triangular tents bottom left

Tahiti beach dream scene (thought-bubble content) fills frame; the blurry white scalloped cloud-frame edge remains around the borders for the whole shot (hard frame vignette, ~7% margin) ; palm tree right, sun, sea, sand. Labels and icons pop on

Night camp: Dutch standing (centre-left), holding a small brown money sack in right hand (raised, right side of him), wooden crate at foot, canvas tent at left, lake and treeline, campfire right, big moon upper left with halo

Saint Denis at sunset (red-orange sky): Arthur (left, hat, red mask? covering lower face, arm raised holding pistol) beside lamp post and brick building; green 'ST. DENIS' tram with silhouetted passengers in lit windows moves slowly right
Warm dark interior (wood-curtain wall, bokeh lights, hanging lantern top-left, table/bar edge at bottom): Arthur (sick/darker face, hat, bandolier) at right, chest-up; tinted amber
Night camp / Dutch's Plans sign shot continues (starts f8371), Dutch waving at right, plantation house, tent; tally on sign reads five-bar gate (||||/); moon right

Top-down desk view: parchment SAINT DENIS town map on dark wood, yellow pencil lower-right, compass rose top-right, river at left, green/tan block grid, 3 gold coin markers, red bank icon. Started before f8460.
Dark wood-plank wall, lantern top-center-left with warm glow, floating dust motes, blank postcard (red stamp square) at right; props pinned. Flat art, static frontal.

Night rain scene, deep blue sky, grey building facade with lit orange windows and gas lamps; 5 Pinkerton agents in dark coats stand in a row at left with rifles, large Pinkerton boss (mustache, bowler hat, badge, arms crossed) at right, 3 silhouettes with rifles on roof. Medium-wide, flat painted.
Dusk camp: tent left, empty wooden chair with dark hat on seat centre, tiny embers on ground; purple-pink sky with faint stars, blue mist tree line. Static wide; shot ends f8841.

Rainy night, blurred bokeh town in background (blue/orange bokeh circles, one lit orange window left), brick-tile floor/rooftop, a flat cap (newsboy cap) lying on ground at centre. Shallow-depth-of-field blur on background. Static.

Night harbour: big glowing full moon with halo top-right-of-centre, dark city skyline silhouette, two-masted ship with cream sails and white deck lights centre-left on dark blue water, wooden pier with red-glowing lantern lower-right, star twinkles. Static wide, flat painted.

Stormy night sea: two-masted steamship with chimney (red band) and cream sails tossed on teal waves with white foam, grey storm clouds, heavy diagonal rain. Ship rocks, then tilts and sinks. Wide, flat vector with parallax waves.

Bright tropical beach: palm trees left and right frame, blue sky with glowing sun top-left, turquoise ocean, sand, Arthur (black hat, beard, brown vest, hands on hips, standing) at centre-right, wooden barrel right, driftwood plank bottom-left. Medium-wide, flat.
Close-up Arthur with fort/soldiers behind (see f9177). Shot ends f9240.
Close-up Arthur, worried/sweating (sweat drops, flushed red cheeks), blurred beach/ocean background with sun glow, palm leaf at left edge; he faces camera, centre-right.

Sunset silhouette scene: orange-red gradient sky, palm tree silhouette left, dark fort with crenellated walls centre-right, sugarcane field foreground, Arthur (hat, rifle slung, hands on hips) standing left-centre, mid-wide. Fort explodes.
Sunset sailboat scene f9340-9379 (see 9340 entry); static composition with gentle boat bob and sun glow; small smoke wisp over island at left.
Close-up Arthur (hat, beard, sunburned red cheeks, tired eyes) against glowing sunset over sea horizon at left-centre; shot f9380-9452.
Night camp two-shot (Arthur left, Dutch right, tent, campfire) f9453-9518; continuing slow push-in. Arthur idle sway, Dutch static hands at belt.

Parchment scroll/book page with leather border and red ribbon bookmark on dark wood backdrop (vignette), sketch of Dutch's face with 'Dutch' label top-right, sketch of horse bottom-right; recurring THINGS TO REMEMBER list. Page initially small at centre then fast push-in.

Night camp by river: wooden hanging sign on gallows-style post left, full moon behind, Dutch (dark coat, red neckerchief, mustache) at right standing and raising a hand (waving), river and dark trees, fireflies. Medium. Starts with sign at left small; camera pushes in.
Chapter V 'The Cough' card hold f9649-9674

Night camp at wagon: lit canvas tent left, covered wagon and brown saddled horse right with glowing arched doorway/cave, rocky dark backdrop with fireflies/embers, small campfire bottom-left, Arthur (hat, vest, hands at belt) standing centre. Medium-wide.

Daytime grey-brown Saint Denis street: red-brick row buildings, lamp posts, green 'ST. DENIS' tram behind, a woman (maroon skirt, white blouse), a man in blue shirt+straw hat, Arthur (hat, vest, hands at belt) at centre, a man in dark coat at right; a blurred foreground bystander enters at left edge from f9762. Medium-wide, flat painted.

Close-medium on Saint Denis street: Arthur large centre, tiny bystanders (woman, straw-hat man, dark-coat man), blurred foreground figures at left and right edges, brick buildings; continues past f9869.

Doctor's office interior: pale green wall, wood wainscot, window left, framed diploma, wall lamp, medicine shelf right. Standing grey-haired doctor in dark coat left holding a paper (chart) over chest; Arthur seated on red-cushion bench centre-right, hands on knees. Wide static shot, full figures.
